parameters.content:
## 1 · Intake
Google Drive folder **01_incoming_snapshots** simulates the mobile-app upload.
Put the folder ID in the trigger. Polling: every minute.

## 2 · MultiSet VPS
`POST /v1/m2m/token` — Basic auth (clientId/clientSecret) → 30-min JWT.
`POST /v1/vps/map/query-form` — multipart.
Set your **mapCode** and real camera intrinsics (fx, fy, px, py, width, height). Max query image side: **1280 px**.
Both nodes use *On Error → Continue*: if MultiSet is not configured, **Normalize Pose** falls back to a mock pose (matching Door_101 of the sample IFC) so the PoC still runs.

## 3 · AI triage → IFC match → dedup
Claude (vision) classifies object / damage / severity / trade; a Code node parses it defensively.
The IFC microservice maps the pose to the nearest IfcProduct (GlobalId).
A second report on the same element does not open a new ticket: it only increments `duplicate_count` (community = same fault reported many times).

## 4 · RAG dispatch cascade
Vector search (Supabase + embeddings) → Claude ranks max 3 candidates → **sequential** Send-and-Wait offers.
Constraints enforced *by construction*:
- only ONE pending offer exists at any time → once somebody accepts, nobody else is ever invited
- the technician can only Accept / Decline; the slot is fixed; 12 h timeout counts as a decline
Queue exhausted or no candidates → status ESCALATED + FM email.

## Setup checklist
1. Replace every REPLACE_WITH_* placeholder.
2. Select credentials on all nodes (Drive, Gmail, Postgres, Supabase, OpenAI embeddings, Anthropic, MultiSet Basic-auth).
3. Create the DB schema (design_document.md, section 11) and run WF0 to fill the vector store.
4. Start the IFC microservice (ifc_service.py) and adjust its URL if not http://ifc-service:8000.
5. After import, verify *Limit Wait Time* = 12 h on the Send-and-Wait node.

parameters.text:
=You are the intake triage engine of a facility-maintenance system. Analyze the attached photo of an issue reported inside a building.

Respond with ONLY a minified JSON object, no markdown fences, no commentary, with exactly these keys:
- object_type: one of door, window, light, hvac, plumbing, furniture, wall, other
- damage_description: one factual sentence describing the visible damage
- severity: one of low, medium, high, critical (critical = immediate safety hazard)
- required_trade: one of carpenter, electrician, plumber, hvac_technician, glazier, generalist
- safety_risk: true or false

If the photo does not show a maintenance issue, use object_type "other", severity "low" and explain why in damage_description.

nodes.name: Parse Triage and Map IFC Class

parameters.query: =SELECT id, status FROM tickets WHERE ifc_global_id = '{{ $json.global_id || 'NO_MATCH' }}' AND ifc_global_id <> 'UNMAPPED' AND status <> 'CLOSED' LIMIT 1;
=UPDATE tickets SET duplicate_count = duplicate_count + 1 WHERE id = {{ $json.id }} RETURNING id, duplicate_count;

parameters.subject: =New maintenance ticket {{ $json.id }} - {{ $json.object_type }} ({{ $json.severity }})
parameters.message:
=A new maintenance ticket has been opened by the community reporting flow.

Ticket: {{ $json.id }}
Object: {{ $json.object_type }} (IFC element: {{ $json.ifc_element_name }} / {{ $json.ifc_global_id }})
Issue: {{ $json.damage_description }}
Severity: {{ $json.severity }} - Safety risk: {{ $json.safety_risk }}
Position (map frame): x={{ $json.pos_x }}, y={{ $json.pos_y }}, z={{ $json.pos_z }} (source: {{ $json.localization_source }})
Photo: {{ $json.photo_url }}

The system is now contacting suitable technicians automatically. You will be notified when one accepts, or if manual assignment is needed.

parameters.prompt: ={{ $('Parse Triage and Map IFC Class').item.json.required_trade }} technician needed for {{ $('Parse Triage and Map IFC Class').item.json.object_type }}: {{ $('Parse Triage and Map IFC Class').item.json.damage_description }} (severity {{ $('Parse Triage and Map IFC Class').item.json.severity }})

parameters.subject: =Job offer - Ticket {{ $json.ticket_id }}: {{ $json.object_type }} repair on {{ $json.slot_human }}
parameters.message:
=Hello {{ $json.name }},

A maintenance job is available and you were selected as the best match ({{ $json.reason }}).

Ticket: {{ $json.ticket_id }}
Object: {{ $json.object_type }}
Reported issue: {{ $json.damage_description }}
Severity: {{ $json.severity }}
Proposed date and time: {{ $json.slot_human }} (Europe/Rome)
Reference photo: {{ $json.photo_url }}

Per company policy the proposed date and time cannot be changed: you can only Accept or Decline this job using the buttons below. If you do not reply within 12 hours the job will be offered to another technician.

parameters.query: =UPDATE tickets SET status = 'ASSIGNED', technician_id = '{{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.tech_id }}', technician_name = '{{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.name_sql }}', technician_email = '{{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.email }}', scheduled_at = '{{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.slot_iso }}' WHERE id = {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.ticket_id }} RETURNING *;

parameters.subject: =Confirmed - Ticket {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.ticket_id }} on {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.slot_human }}
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.name }},

Thank you for accepting ticket {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.ticket_id }} ({{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.object_type }}: {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.damage_description }}).
Confirmed slot: {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.slot_human }} (fixed, cannot be changed).
Reference photo: {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.photo_url }}

When the work is done: take a photo of the repaired object and upload it to the shared folder 02_completed_snapshots (REPLACE_WITH_COMPLETED_FOLDER_LINK), naming the file exactly TICKET-{{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.ticket_id }}.jpg. The facility manager will then review and approve the intervention.

parameters.subject: =Ticket {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.ticket_id }} assigned to {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.name }}
parameters.message:
=Ticket {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.ticket_id }} ({{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.object_type }}) has been accepted by {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.name }} ({{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.email }}).
Scheduled: {{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.slot_human }}.
No other technician has been or will be invited for this ticket.

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO dispatch_log (ticket_id, technician_id, response) VALUES ({{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.ticket_id }}, '{{ $('Loop Technicians').item.json.tech_id }}', 'declined_or_timeout') RETURNING id;
=UPDATE tickets SET status = 'ESCALATED' WHERE id = {{ $('Create Ticket').first().json.id }} RETURNING *;

parameters.subject: =ACTION NEEDED - Ticket {{ $('Create Ticket').first().json.id }} requires manual assignment
parameters.message:
=Ticket {{ $('Create Ticket').first().json.id }} ({{ $('Create Ticket').first().json.object_type }}: {{ $('Create Ticket').first().json.damage_description }}) could not be assigned automatically: no suitable technician was found, or every contacted technician declined / did not answer within the time limit.

The ticket status is now ESCALATED and requires your manual assignment.
